resources.string: Permissions
These let Simha look after you properly. You choose what to allow, and you can change it any time.
Allow everything Simha needs
Everything is allowed. Simha is ready.
Before we begin

Simha will ask Android for these things, one by one:

Hear you and talk with you. Call and message your family when you ask, or when you need help. See your contacts so you can pick a person by name. Know where you are so family can find you in an emergency. Use the camera when you ask. Show reminders, wake the screen and speak loudly when it is time for medicine. Stay running in the background. Help you use other apps on this phone, such as WhatsApp or YouTube, only when you ask.

You stay in charge. You can turn any of these off later.
Continue
Not now
Cancel
Please confirm it is you
Use your fingerprint, face or phone lock.
On
Off
Turn off %1$s
Open settings
Android does not let apps switch this off. Simha will open the right page so you can do it there.
Simha uses this to read what is on screen and to tap or go back, only when you ask Simha to help with another app.
Microphone
So Simha can hear you and talk with you.
Simha will not be able to hear you.
Phone calls
So Simha can call your family or the doctor for you.
Simha will only open the dialler and you will have to press call yourself.
Text messages
So Simha can send a message to your family when you ask.
Simha will not be able to send messages for you.
Contacts
So you can pick a person from your phone by name.
You will have to type phone numbers yourself.
Location
So your family can find you in an emergency.
Simha cannot share where you are when you need help.
Camera
So Simha can use the camera when you ask.
Simha will not be able to use the camera.
Notifications
So Simha can show reminders and messages.
You will not see reminders from Simha.
Physical activity
So Simha can notice if you have been still for a long time.
Simha will not notice when you have not moved for a long time.
Show over other apps
So Simha can come on screen even when another app is open.
Simha can only show a notification and cannot come on screen.
Exact alarms
So medicine reminders ring at the right minute.
Reminders may come a little late.
Keep running
So Android does not put Simha to sleep.
Android may stop Simha and reminders may be missed.
Full screen alerts
So reminders and alerts can fill the screen when the phone is locked.
Alerts will not fill the screen over the lock screen.
Do Not Disturb access
So Simha can still reach you when the phone is on silent.
Simha may stay quiet when the phone is on silent.
Change phone settings
So Simha can raise the volume or brightness for you.
Simha will not be able to change volume or brightness.
Phone control
So Simha can open and use other apps for you when you ask.
Simha will not be able to use other apps for you.
